displayName: AI resources not covered by other log checks should have diagnostic logs enabled
description: Audit Azure ML online endpoints and registries, Bot Service, and Video Indexer accounts without a diagnostic setting that enables at least one log category or category group. Destination is not checked. Cognitive Services, Search, and ML workspaces are covered by B28, B29, and B30.

builtInReview.gap: Live built-ins for these types are DeployIfNotExists logging policies that require a destination parameter.

metadata.description: AuditIfNotExists reports resources without enabled diagnostic logs. Deny cannot implement this existence check.
